notes.text: Narendra Damodardas Narendra Modi is an Indian politician who has served as the prime minister of India since 26 May 2014.
Narendra Modi was the chief minister of Gujarat from 2001 to 2014 and is the Member of Parliament (MP) for Varanasi.
Narendra Modi is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), a right-wing Hindutva paramilitary volunteer organisation.
Narendra Modi is India's third-longest-serving prime minister, and the longest-serving prime minister outside the Indian National Congress.
Narendra Modi is remembered as a politician connected with India.
